content: Dr. Maged Younes, a specialist in health, iron, and vitamin A nutrition, has contributed to program research under the Committee on World Food Security at the Food and Agriculture Organization in Rome, Italy. His expertise spans food safety, public health, and program management. Dr. Robert J. Berry, from the Prevention Research Branch at the National Center on Birth Defects and Developmental Disabilities, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention in Atlanta, USA, specializes in epidemiology, folate, and food fortification. Dr. Andreas Bluethner, affiliated with BASF SE in Limburgerhof, Germany, focuses on fortificants and food fortification. Dr. Julia Finkelstein, based at Cornell University in Ithaca, USA, is an expert in epidemiology and systematic reviews. Dr. Elvira González de Mejía, from the Department of Food Science and Human Nutrition at the University of Illinois in Urbana, USA, specializes in fortification procedures and fortificants. Dr. Jeff Gwirtz, associated with the Food Fortification Initiative in Manhattan, USA, has expertise in milling and grain fortification. Professor Richard Hurrell, from the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Zurich, Switzerland, focuses on iron metabolism, bioavailability, and fortification. Dr. Chowdhury Jalal, working with the Micronutrient Initiative in Ottawa, Canada, specializes in systematic reviews, micronutrient stability, and monitoring and evaluation. Mr. Phillip J. Makhumula-Nkhoma, an independent consultant based in Lilongwe, Malawi, has expertise in legislation and regulatory affairs. Dr. Luis A. Mejía, from the Department of Food Science and Human Nutrition at the University of Illinois in Urbana, USA, focuses on regulatory affairs. Dr. Regina Moench-Pfanner, affiliated with the Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition (GAIN) in Geneva, Switzerland, specializes in food fortification and nutrition programs. Dr. Helena Pachón, from the Food Fortification Initiative at Emory University in Atlanta, USA, is a nutrition scientist. Mr. Peter Ranum, an independent consultant based in Tucson, USA, has expertise in industrial milling and fortification. Mr. Georg Steiger, from DSM Nutritional Products in Kaiseraugst, Switzerland, focuses on fortificants, micronutrients, and biochemistry. Dr. Parminder S. Suchdev, from the Department of Pediatrics and Global Health at Emory University in Atlanta, USA, specializes in pediatrics and global health. Dr. Nancy J. Aburto, a nutrition adviser with the United Nations World Food Programme in Rome, Italy, has contributed her expertise. Mr. Ronald Afidra Olema, the Africa Network Coordinator for the Food Fortification Initiative in Kampala, Uganda, has provided his insights. Dr. Laillou Arnaud, a nutrition specialist with the United Nations Children’s Fund in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, has shared his expertise. Dr. Omar Dary, a health science specialist in nutrition with the Bureau of Global Health at the U.S. Agency for International Development in Washington, D.C., USA, has contributed to this work. The names and affiliations of these experts and peer reviewers are acknowledged here, but their inclusion does not imply endorsement of the recommendations in the guideline.
